authPanel.title: Your route to Japan starts at N5.
authPanel.body: Take the free level check, then practise with mock tests under real exam conditions.
authPanel.stations: Level check route: N5, then N4, then N3

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Free. Start with the level check from N5.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {email} can be used for an account, we've sent a link to confirm it. Open the email and select the button to finish.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: We've sent a link to confirm your email address. Open the email and select the button to finish.
checkEmail.resendPrompt: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
checkEmail.resent: If the address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.successBody: Your account is ready. Log in to start your level check.
verify.errorBody: It may have been used already or replaced by a newer one. Enter your email to get a new link.
verify.missingToken: This page needs the link from your email.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back.
login.notVerified: Confirm your email first. We can send the link again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If there's an account for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Your password has been changed and you've been logged out on all devices. Log in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This page needs the link from your password-reset email.

errors.cancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again, or use your email and password.
errors.expired: That Google sign-in took too long or was started in another window. Please try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't sign you in with Google. Please try again, or use your email and password.
errors.disabled: This account has been suspended. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
errors.unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Log in with your email and password.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

levelCheck.not_started: Not started yet. The level check opens in an upcoming update.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields need attention. Check them and try again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Log in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You can't do that from here.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is suspended. Contact support.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SECONDS: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.LEVEL_NOT_DETERMINED: Finish the level check to unlock this.

notFound.title: This page isn't on the route map
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

levelCheck.title: Find your level
levelCheck.intro: Before you study or take mock tests, a short level check finds the right place to start. It's free and runs in stages.
levelCheck.ruleClimb: Pass a stage to move on to the next one. You can't choose a level or skip one.
levelCheck.ruleStop: It stops at the first stage you don't pass. Your level is the highest stage you passed; if you don't pass {first}, you start at {first}.
levelCheck.ruleUnlock: When it is complete, your study materials, mock tests and results open.
levelCheck.ready: {count} stages, up to {minutes} minutes in total. Each stage is timed separately.
levelCheck.inProgress: Your level check is in progress. Continue where you left off; the timer of a started stage keeps running.

home.studyBody: Materials for your level and the levels below it.
home.mockTestsBody: Practise under real exam conditions at any level.

study.empty: No study materials have been published yet. They'll appear here as soon as they are.
study.noneForFilter: No materials match these filters yet.
study.audioUnsupported: Your browser cannot play this audio.
study.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be shown. Reload the page to try again.

mockTests.empty: No mock tests have been published yet. They'll appear here as soon as they are.
mockTests.intro: Practise for the exam you are aiming for. Tests appear here as soon as they are published.

results.empty: You don't have any results yet. Take a mock test and your score will appear here.

yourLevel.title: Your level
yourLevel.beginnerLead: You start at {level}, the beginning of the route.

exam.reviewBody: You answered {answered} of {total} questions. Unanswered questions count as wrong.
exam.timeUp: Time is up. Your answers were submitted.
exam.staleTitle: This test continues in another tab
exam.staleBody: You opened this stage somewhere else. Continue here to take it back; the other tab will stop.
exam.loadError: We couldn't load your test. Check your connection and try again.
exam.stagePassedBody: Well done. The next stage is {next}. Its timer starts when you press Start.
